motion_rule: camera always moving, new shot size every beat, never wider than a mid shot, something fills the lens each beat
character: one city pigeon all 10 s, flying low and level, wings beating every beat, beak empty, opening on every syllable, lit hot white, never a silhouette
second_characters: crows in flat caps, ONE crow at the lens every beat, A SWARM from both sides at 2.75, two with flick-knives on her from 6.80
props: a fat leather wallet under her left wing, a slice of white bread under her right, wooden pins, white sheets on three lines
environment: a back yard at night, every window of the brick block blazing yellow, a white floodlight on a pole, three lines of white sheets lit like screens, brick chimneys behind, black sky, a full moon

light_events.event: night, but the yard is bright: the floodlight burns from the left all clip, the lit sheets bounce white into her face, lit windows behind her every beat

audio.delivery: female, low, dry, angry, level, 3.3 syllables per second
audio.pronunciation: Ot-LO-zhish na CHYOR-ny DEN, pri-DYOT CHYOR-na-ya NOCH. DEN-gi ne spa-SUT, TOL-ko KRY-lya
audio.pacing: first word on frame one, speech unbroken to 6.80, then not a word, only wingbeats, knives and caws to 10.00
sfx: wingbeats close to the mic, sheets snapping, crow caws, crust tearing at 4.70, a wing roar at 6.20, knives ringing at 7.60, a body blow at 8.30

timeline.action: she bursts from behind a floodlit sheet across frame, the sheet wiping the lens, the wallet under her left wing
she rips under a sagging line and out at the lens, ONE crow cutting past the other way, sheets and pins whipping past
she banks around a chimney, tiles and pins rushing at the lens
A SWARM of crows pours in from both sides past the lens, she rolls through the gap, the floodlight flaring between their wings
she flings the bread over her shoulder at the lens
she beats through the crows while they tear the bread to crumbs across frame, crumbs bursting at the lens
she snaps both wings wide and drives across frame over the lit sheets, the yard sweeping under
punch: she dives into the lens, wings filling the frame, orange eyes on us, beak wide open
two crows close from both sides at the lens and rip the wallet from under her left wing, she flies on
the two crows snap knives at her across frame, blades raking her, sparks and torn feathers bursting at the lens
she wheels back and slams into the nearer crow at the lens, his cap and knife spinning away, black feathers exploding
the second crow lunges with the blade, she catches his wing in her beak and drags him across frame
she throws him off and comes at the lens, wings wide, a black feather in her beak, the lit yard rushing under her

must_appear: night, windows and floodlight burning, her face lit white every beat, her dive filling the lens at 6.20, all words by 6.80, the wallet ripped away at 6.90, she slams the nearer crow at 8.30, she drags the second by the wing at 9.00, a black feather in her beak at the lens by 9.60
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, digits, Latin letters, a static camera, standing in place, slow motion, a closed beak while speaking, English speech, blood, gore, darkness, an unlit scene, a silhouette, a storm, rain, a repeated word, a wide shot
